The segfault occurs at exit because libgeotiff5/libspatialite7 installed from jammy link against libproj.so.22 (old, without the new ABI?) Actually the crash is in osgeo::proj::~UnitOfMeasure from libproj.so.22 during exit handlers. There are two libproj loaded (22 and 25), causing the crash.

Wait — actually the PPA installed libspatialite8 and libgeotiff? Let me look. We installed libgdal-dev from PPA which pulled libspatialite8, libgeotiff 1.7.1-5? But dpkg shows libgeotiff5 installed 1.7.0-2build1 and libspatialite7 5.0.1-2build2 still old. Hmm mixed.

Let me upgrade libgeotiff5/libspatialite7 to PPA versions which likely link libproj25.

Actually the crash is at interpreter exit only — the script output was produced successfully (45 lines), then segfault at shutdown. That's a cosmetic issue but causes exit code 139. However the requested install is successful if script works. But a segfault on exit is concerning. Let's try to fix by upgrading packages.

Let me upgrade the remaining geo libs to PPA versions.
